analysis.title: V2X Inc. (VVX): 3Q26 First Take: Solid overall, though some inputs mixed
key_insights: VVX reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $1.64 versus FactSet consensus of $1.50 and GS estimate of $1.46. Revenue was $1.27bn, up 9% y/y and 5.1% above the GS estimate.
Adjusted EBITDA of $88.6mn was 0.5% below consensus and 0.6% above the GS estimate. The 7.0% EBITDA margin was 30 bps below both consensus and the GS estimate.
Calculated total book to bill was 1.1X in the quarter (1.2X TTM) and calculated funded book to bill was 1.1X (1.1X TTM). Total backlog rose 1% q/q and 11% y/y.
Adjusted free cash flow of $58.5mn was below consensus of $82mn.
VVX raised 2026 guidance on revenue, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS and adjusted CFO. The new ranges bracket consensus for revenue, EBITDA and EPS.
The company said it expects revenue to grow and margins to expand in 2027, with a few puts and takes.
GS rates VVX Sell with a 12-month price target of $67, 19.5% below the $83.20 close on 2 Nov 2026. The target uses 7.5X 5-8QE EV/EBITDA.
The EPS beat versus the GS estimate came mainly from lower net interest expense ($14.0mn vs $17.0mn estimated) and a lower tax rate (23.0% vs 23.5% estimated), with EBT $6.1mn above estimate.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 EPS and revenue beat consensus and 2026 guidance was raised, but EBITDA margin was below consensus and free cash flow missed. The $67 target sits 19.5% below the $83.20 price.

earnings_insights: VVX 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $1.64 vs FactSet consensus $1.50 and GS estimate $1.46 (3Q25: $1.37, +19.5% y/y).
3Q26 revenue reported $1,271.5mn vs GS estimate $1,210.2mn (+5.1%), up 8.9% y/y from $1,167.1mn.
3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported $88.6mn vs GS estimate $88.1mn, 0.5% below consensus. Adjusted EBITDA margin reported 7.0% vs GS estimate 7.3%, 30 bps below consensus.
3Q26 adjusted free cash flow reported $58.5mn vs consensus $82mn.

2026 guidance raised in Nov: revenue $4,950-$5,100mn (prior $4,875-$5,025mn, consensus $4,977mn), adjusted EBITDA $353-$368mn (prior $348-$363mn, consensus $358mn), adjusted EPS $6.15-$6.55 (prior $5.90-$6.30, consensus $6.23), adjusted CFO $175-$195mn (prior $160-$180mn).
GS forecasts (estimates, not reported): FY26E revenue $4,988.3mn, EBITDA $358.9mn, EPS $6.20. FY27E revenue $5,199.0mn, EBITDA $375.3mn, EPS $6.64.
Total backlog is up 1% q/q and 11% y/y.
risk_factors: Contract renewal and potential new wins.
